abstract: Tracks local fisher guild advisory concurrence and commercial vessel impact
system_message:
You are Commercial Liaison Officer (CLO). The Commercial Liaison Officer (CLO) monitors local fisher guild advisory concurrence, assesses commercial vessel impact, and tracks economic disruption mitigation reserves for maritime evacuation corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Economic disruption mitigation（CLAIMS）
information_points.content:
CLO-CLAIMS-1WK：For the North Head Outer Passage, the settled compensation contingency fund established for commercial fishery seasonal rerouting disruption holds 75000 USD.
CLO-CLAIMS-LP8：For the Point Carmelo Inshore Channel, the settled compensation contingency fund designated for commercial fishery seasonal rerouting disruption amounts to 25000 USD.
CLO-CLAIMS-F6I：For the Shoalwater Deep Sound Route, the pre-authorized disruption reserve allocated under the settled compensation contingency fund is 50000 USD.

information_points.title: Tracks local fisher guild advisory concurrence and commercial vessel impact（GUILD）
information_points.content:
CLO-GUILD-7G0：For the North Head Outer Passage, the fisher guild advisory concurrence rating stands at 68%, reflecting the share of licensed vessel captains among registered fleet operators endorsing the corridor routing.
CLO-GUILD-7RB：For the Point Carmelo Inshore Channel, the fisher guild advisory concurrence rating reaches 94% among licensed vessel captains operating along channel approaches.
CLO-GUILD-LI0：For the Shoalwater Deep Sound Route, the fisher guild advisory concurrence rating is recorded at 82% based on consultations with registered fleet operators.
